description: Update the plugin docs and CHANGELOG for the 7 new stem-targeted instrumental plugins. Keep the Suno Studio / post-render / not-a-lyric-tag framing and add PER-STEM emphasis. Depends on FEAT-001 (the plugins must exist and their ids/displayNames must be known).
steps: UPDATE plugins/README.md: (a) Add a short intro note (near the top framing) that Suno Studio splits a rendered song into stems (vocals, drums, bass, guitar, keys, strings, synth, brass, percussion, backing vocals, FX, other) and these effects are meant to be dropped onto a SPECIFIC stem. (b) Extend the 'Layout' code block to list the 7 new subfolders with one-line descriptions. (c) Extend the 'Plugin to KB use-case mapping' table with a row per new plugin; each row's use-case cell must state the TARGET STEM in the form 'apply to the <bass/keys/guitar/strings/synth/backing vocals/FX> stem in Suno Studio' plus the KB use-case it serves (deep sub-bass pulse/distorted bass; felt piano/distant Rhodes/intimate ballads; acoustic warmth <-> distorted guitar; cinematic/chamber/distant strings; Fractured Shadows cold synths / MODE C; the () backup-vocal technique; room tone / FX-texture beds). (d) Update the 'Tier 1 (built)' list to include the 7 new plugins (now 13 total) with their ids. (e) KEEP the existing UNVERIFIED note and the Tier 2 section UNCHANGED (Tier 2 still defers reverb/delay/space/noise/SFX/LFO/oscillator/FFT).

UPDATE plugins/AUTHORING.md ONLY if a new documented assumption arises. The synth and texture plugins reuse the existing digital-degrade quantizer, which is already documented under 'Known DSP limitations'. If reusing it verbatim, either leave AUTHORING.md as-is or add a one-line note that the quantizer technique is now shared by synth-cold-glitch and texture-filter-degrade. Do not introduce new unconfirmed primitives or new assumptions beyond what the existing plugins already rely on. Introduce the static-attenuation tuck (backing-vocal-tucker) note only if it represents a new assumption; a plain static g.mul gain reduction needs no new primitive and can simply be documented in that plugin's header comment.

UPDATE CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased] / ### Added: add ONE new bullet (matching the existing bullet style, no em dashes) announcing the stem-targeted instrumental plugin set. Name all 7 plugins and their target stems: Sub Tightener (bass), Warm Keys Voicer (keys), Guitar Grit / Warmth (guitar), String Air / Size (strings), Synth Cold / Glitch (synth), Backing Vocal Tucker (backing vocals), Texture Filter / Degrade (FX/other). State they use only confirmed g.* primitives, that the synth/texture degrade reuses the digital-degrade fixed-depth quantizer, and that status is UNVERIFIED pending in-Suno testing.
Leave the top-level README.md as-is unless a plugin count/description there needs updating; check it first and only touch it if it states a specific plugin count.
Re-run the JSON validation to confirm docs edits did not touch any JSON, and grep the edited docs for em dashes to confirm none were introduced.
acceptance_criteria: plugins/README.md contains a per-stem intro note, lists all 7 new plugins in the Layout block, has a use-case table row for each of the 7 naming its target stem in the 'apply to the <stem> stem in Suno Studio' form, and its Tier 1 list now enumerates 13 built plugins.
The existing UNVERIFIED note and the Tier 2 deferral section in plugins/README.md are preserved and still defer reverb/delay/space/noise/SFX/LFO/oscillator/FFT.
CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased]/Added has one new bullet naming all 7 plugins with their target stems, matching existing bullet style, containing no em dashes.
No em dashes are introduced in plugins/README.md, plugins/AUTHORING.md, or CHANGELOG.md new content.
top-level README.md is only changed if it stated a plugin count that is now stale.
verification: grep for the 7 displayNames (Sub Tightener, Warm Keys Voicer, Guitar Grit, String Air, Synth Cold, Backing Vocal Tucker, Texture Filter) in plugins/README.md and confirm each appears in the use-case table with a target-stem phrase.
grep -n 'Tier 2' plugins/README.md and read the section to confirm it is unchanged and still lists the deferred categories.
grep -n 'instrumental' CHANGELOG.md (or read the top of [Unreleased]/Added) and confirm the new bullet names all 7 plugins and their stems.
grep for the unicode em dash across plugins/README.md, plugins/AUTHORING.md, and the added CHANGELOG lines and confirm zero matches.
findings: Docs-only update for the 7 stem-targeted instrumental plugins. plugins/README.md: (a) added a per-stem intro note (Suno Studio splits a rendered song into stems: vocals, drums, bass, guitar, keys, strings, synth, brass, percussion, backing vocals, FX, other) explaining each plugin is dropped onto a SPECIFIC stem; (b) extended the Layout code block with 7 new subfolders + one-line descriptions; (c) added 7 use-case table rows, each stating the target stem in the 'Apply to the <bass/keys/guitar/strings/synth/backing vocals/FX> stem in Suno Studio' form plus the KB use-case (deep sub-bass pulse/distorted bass; felt piano/distant Rhodes/intimate ballads; acoustic warmth through distorted/overdriven guitar; cinematic/chamber/distant strings; Fractured Shadows cold synths / MODE C; the () backup-vocal technique; room tone / FX-texture beds); (d) rewrote the Tier 1 list to enumerate all 13 built plugins with ids (first 6 vocals, last 7 stem-targeted, stems noted with commas not em dashes). The existing UNVERIFIED note and Tier 2 section (still defers reverb/delay/space/noise/SFX/LFO/oscillator/FFT) are UNCHANGED. plugins/AUTHORING.md: added a one-line note under the existing digital-degrade 'Known DSP limitations' bullet that the fixed-depth quantizer staircase is now reused verbatim by synth-cold-glitch and texture-filter-degrade and remains the one sanctioned degrade technique; no new primitives or assumptions introduced. CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased]/Added: added ONE new bullet (matching existing style) naming all 7 plugins with target stems, stating confirmed g.* primitives only, that synth/texture degrade reuses the digital-degrade fixed-depth 8-level quantizer, and status UNVERIFIED pending in-Suno testing. Top-level README.md: updated the stale 'Six Tier-1 plugins ship today' line to 'Thirteen Tier-1 plugins' with the vocals-stem six and the seven stem-targeted instrumental plugins (their stems) listed. VERIFICATION: python3 JSON parse prints '13 files OK' (docs edits touched no JSON); plugins/README.md and plugins/AUTHORING.md have 0 em dashes; the new CHANGELOG bullet and new README content are em-dash-free (pre-existing em dashes elsewhere in CHANGELOG.md and README.md were left untouched); Tier 2 section confirmed present and unchanged at lines 99/119/128; all 7 'Apply to the <stem> stem in Suno Studio' phrases present. NOT committed (orchestrator commits).
